note: Apply-to-get credit programs (startup + student/research). Kept separate from providers.json (which is self-serve, verified free APIs) because these need an application and are highly volatile. `funds`: 'yes' = first-party LLM-API credits, 'partial' = cloud/compute credits usable for managed LLM APIs, 'no' = training/perks only. Confirmed against each program's own page on 2026-07-30.

startups.name: AWS Activate
startups.what: Up to $200k AWS credits (marketing max; self-serve tier far smaller); explicitly redeemable on Bedrock LLMs
startups.who: Any stage; top tiers need a referral from an approved AWS Activate provider

startups.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
startups.what: Up to $150k Azure credits (unlocked across tiers); covers Azure OpenAI
startups.who: Software startups; no stage/funding threshold; services-only firms excluded

startups.name: Google for Startups Cloud
startups.what: Up to $200k GCP credits over 2 yr (up to $350k for AI-focused startups); covers Vertex AI / Gemini
startups.who: Equity-funded early-stage, no prior GCP credits; higher tiers via accelerator/VC

startups.name: OVHcloud Startup
startups.what: €10k (Start) to €100k (Scale) cloud credits over 12 months + engineer time

startups.name: Anthropic — Claude for Startups
startups.what: Free Claude API credits + priority rate limits (amount not published)
startups.who: Equity-backed, founded <4 yr ago, no prior Anthropic credits; first-party API only

startups.name: OpenAI Startup Program
startups.what: Free OpenAI API credits + rate-limit upgrades + SE time
startups.who: Backed by a partner-network VC; needs an investor referral code — not self-serve

startups.name: Cohere Startup Program
startups.what: Reduced API pricing + support (discount % not on the official page)
startups.who: Early-stage AI startups; zero-equity; rolling applications

startups.name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
startups.what: Up to $15k / $30k / $50k platform credits by funding tier (hosted open models + fine-tuning)

startups.name: Fireworks AI Startup Program
startups.what: "Build credits" + higher rate limits (amount not published)

startups.name: Baseten AI Startup Program
startups.what: Up to $27.5k credits ($25k dedicated + $2.5k Model APIs) + eng support
startups.who: Seed–Series A, <5 yr, AI-central, new customer

startups.name: Nebius for Startups
startups.what: $5k intro credits (~1,600 H100-hrs) + up to $100k discounts (GPU/compute)

startups.name: Modal for Startups
startups.who: Seed–B+, VC-backed or >$1M raised, new customer

startups.name: NVIDIA Inception
startups.what: Preferred hardware pricing, partner cloud credits, training, ecosystem access

startups.name: Scaleway Startup Program
startups.what: €1k / €9k / €36k credits by tier; covers Generative APIs
startups.who: <5 yr, <50 employees, going to market, not yet a client (EU)

research.name: Azure for Students
research.what: $100 Azure credit / 12 mo, no card; covers Azure OpenAI
research.who: Full-time university students, verify with a school email

research.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
research.what: GitHub Copilot access + $100 Azure credit + many dev tools

research.name: Cohere Labs — Catalyst Grants
research.what: Free Cohere LLM API access for eligible projects

research.name: Google TPU Research Cloud
research.what: Free access to 1,000+ Cloud TPUs to train/run models
research.who: ML researchers; apply; must share results publicly

research.name: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
research.what: Up to $5k (students) / uncapped (faculty) AWS credits; covers Bedrock
research.who: Faculty, research staff or grad students at accredited institutions

research.name: Google Cloud Research Credits
research.what: GCP credits (proposal-based); covers Vertex AI / Gemini; non-commercial
research.who: Faculty / PhD / postdoc at accredited institutions

research.name: NVIDIA Academic Grant
research.what: GPU-hours / hardware grants (e.g. up to 30k H100-hrs)

research.name: Lambda Research Grants
research.what: Up to $5k Lambda GPU cloud credits

research.name: AWS Educate
research.what: Free training, labs and badges (no spendable credits)
